en.t: 638 g all-purpose flour
99 g granulated sugar
1 tsp (3 g) instant or rapid-rise yeast
368 g milk
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)
1 1/2 tsp (9 g) table salt
8 tbsp (114 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm pieces and softened
1680 g vegetable oil, for frying
369 g confectioners' sugar
114 g hot water
Pinch table salt
1. **FOR THE DOUGHNUTS:**

2. Stir flour, sugar, and yeast together in bowl of stand mixer. Add milk and egg and mix with rubber spatula until all ingredients are moistened. Fit stand mixer with dough hook and mix on medium-low speed until cohesive mass forms, about 2 minutes, scraping down bowl if necessary. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let stand for 20 minutes.

3. Add salt and mix on medium-low speed until dough is smooth and elastic and clears sides of bowl, 5 to 7 minutes. With mixer running, add butter, a few pieces at a time, and continue to mix until butter is fully incorporated and dough is smooth and elastic and clears sides of bowl, 7 to 13 minutes longer, scraping down bowl halfway through mixing. Transfer dough to lightly greased large bowl, flip dough, and form into ball. Cover bowl with plastic. Let sit at room temperature for 1 hour. Transfer to refrigerator and chill overnight (or up to 48 hours).

4. Adjust oven racks to lowest and middle positions. Place loaf pan on lower rack. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and grease parchment. Transfer dough to lightly floured counter. Press into 20 cm square of even thickness, expelling as much air as possible. Roll dough into 25 × 33 cm rectangle, about 1.5 cm thick. Using 7.5 cm round cutter dipped in flour, cut 12 rounds. Using 2.5 cm cutter dipped in flour, cut hole out of center of each round. Transfer doughnuts and holes to prepared sheet. (If desired, use 2.5 cm cutter to cut small rounds from remaining dough. Transfer to sheet with doughnuts.) Bring kettle or small saucepan of water to boil.

5. Pour 235 ml boiling water into loaf pan. Place sheet on upper rack, uncovered. Close oven and allow doughnuts to rise until dough increases in height by 50 percent and springs back very slowly when pressed with your knuckle, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
6. **FOR THE GLAZE:**
7. Whisk sugar, water, and salt in medium bowl until smooth.

8. About 20 minutes before end of rising time, add oil to large Dutch oven until it measures about 4 cm deep and heat over medium-low heat to 180 °C. Set wire rack in second rimmed baking sheet and line with triple layer of paper towels. Using both your hands, gently place 4 risen doughnuts in oil. Cook until golden brown on undersides, 1 to 1½ minutes, adjusting burner as necessary to maintain oil temperature between 175 and 185 °C. Using spider skimmer, flip doughnuts and cook until second sides are browned, 1 to 1½ minutes. Transfer doughnuts to prepared rack. Return oil to 180 °C and repeat with remaining doughnuts. For doughnut holes, transfer all to oil and stir gently and constantly until golden brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer to prepared rack to cool. Let doughnuts sit until cool enough to handle, at least 5 minutes.

9. Set clean wire rack in now-empty sheet. Working with 1 doughnut at a time, dip both sides of doughnut in glaze, allowing excess to drip back into bowl. Place on unlined rack. Repeat with doughnut holes. Let doughnuts and holes stand until glaze has become slightly matte and dry to touch, 15 to 30 minutes, before serving.

2. V mise kuchynského robota zmiešame múku, cukor a droždie. Pridáme mlieko a vajce a gumenou stierkou miešame, kým sa všetky suroviny nezvlhčia. Misu prikryjeme fóliou a necháme 20 minút odpočívať.

3. Pridáme soľ a miešame na strednej až nízkej rýchlosti, kým nie je cesto hladké a pružné a neodlepí sa od stien misy, 5 až 7 minút. Za chodu robota postupne pridávame maslo po niekoľkých kúskoch a miešame, kým sa úplne nezapracuje a cesto nie je opäť hladké, pružné a neodlepí sa od stien misy, ešte 7 až 13 minút; v polovici miešania cesto zo stien misy stierame. Cesto preložíme do veľkej, zľahka vymastenej misy, obrátime ho a vytvarujeme guľu. Misu prikryjeme fóliou. Necháme 1 hodinu pri izbovej teplote, potom preložíme do chladničky a necháme chladiť cez noc (najviac 48 hodín).

4. Rošty v rúre posunieme do najnižšej a strednej polohy. Na spodný rošt postavíme formu na chlebík. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie a papier vymastíme. Cesto preložíme na zľahka pomúčenú pracovnú dosku. Rukami ho roztlačíme na štvorec 20 × 20 cm s rovnomernou hrúbkou a vytlačíme z neho čo najviac vzduchu. Cesto vyvaľkáme na obdĺžnik 25 × 33 cm, hrubý asi 1,5 cm. Okrúhlym vykrajovačom s priemerom 7,5 cm namočeným v múke vykrojíme 12 kruhov. Vykrajovačom s priemerom 2,5 cm namočeným v múke vykrojíme v strede každého kruhu otvor. Šišky aj stredy preložíme na pripravený plech. (Podľa chuti vykrajovačom s priemerom 2,5 cm vykrojíme zo zvyšného cesta malé guľky a dáme ich na plech k šiškám.) V rýchlovarnej kanvici alebo malom hrnci privedieme vodu do varu.

5. Do formy na chlebík nalejeme 235 ml vriacej vody. Plech postavíme na horný rošt, neprikrytý. Rúru zatvoríme (nezapíname ju) a necháme šišky kysnúť, kým cesto nezväčší výšku o 50 % a po zatlačení kĺbom prsta sa veľmi pomaly nevracia späť, 45 minút až 1 hodinu.
6. **NA POLEVU:**
7. V strednej mise metličkou vymiešame cukor, vodu a soľ dohladka.

8. Asi 20 minút pred koncom kysnutia nalejeme do veľkého liatinového hrnca olej do výšky asi 4 cm a na strednom až miernom ohni ho zohrejeme na 180 °C. Do druhého plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a vystelieme ju trojitou vrstvou papierových utierok. Oboma rukami opatrne vložíme do oleja 4 vykysnuté šišky. Vyprážame, kým nie sú zospodu zlatohnedé, 1 až 1½ minúty; plameň podľa potreby upravujeme tak, aby teplota oleja zostala medzi 175 a 185 °C. Cedidlovou naberačkou šišky obrátime a vyprážame, kým nie je zhnednutá aj druhá strana, 1 až 1½ minúty. Šišky preložíme na pripravenú mriežku. Olej opäť zohrejeme na 180 °C a rovnako vypražíme zvyšné šišky. Stredy šišiek vložíme do oleja naraz a za jemného, neustáleho miešania ich vyprážame dozlatista, asi 2 minúty. Preložíme ich na pripravenú mriežku vychladnúť. Šišky necháme aspoň 5 minút vychladnúť, kým sa nedajú vziať do ruky.

9. Do vyprázdneného plechu vložíme čistú mriežku. Šišky po jednej namáčame z oboch strán do polevy a prebytok necháme stiecť späť do misy. Ukladáme ich na mriežku bez utierok. Rovnako oblejeme aj stredy šišiek. Pred podávaním necháme šišky aj stredy odpočívať, kým poleva nezmatnie a nie je na dotyk suchá, 15 až 30 minút.

1. While you prepare the dough, begin heating the lard (best flavor), shortening (less saturated fat but also less flavor), or vegetable oil (probably the healthiest alternative but if you're doing these for flavor, this is not the choice to make). A 7570 ml stock pot is an appropriate size cooking container.
2. Slowly start to heat melt/heat the fat over medium heat; you want it to reach somewhere between 185 °C and 190 °C before you begin to cook.
3. Beat together the eggs, buttermilk, sugar and lemon oil or zest until light. In a separate bowl, blend together the dry ingredients.

4. Melt the butter, but make sure it's not excessively hot. Quickly blend the dry ingredients with the wet and stir in the melted butter. The resulting dough will be quite soft, but if you keep your work surfaces well sprinkled with flour, you can deal with it it.

5. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead four or five times to make it cohesive (a baker's bench knife helps here). Then, with a well-floured rolling pin, roll the dough out until it's about 1.5 cm thick.
6. With a doughnut cutter dipped in flour (each time you cut), cut out doughnuts. Save the "holes" or re-roll them with leftover dough. Try to handle the dough as little as possible.

The doughnuts will initially sink to the bottom of the pot but will rise shortly. Give them about a minute on one side, then flip them over and give them another minute.
8. Flip them a third time and cook for another 30 seconds. Drain on paper towels (or brown paper grocery bags).

1. Kým pripravujeme cesto, začneme zohrievať tuk na vyprážanie: rastlinný stužený tuk (výraznejšia chuť) alebo rastlinný olej (zdravšia voľba). Vhodný je hrniec s objemom 7570 ml.
2. Tuk pomaly rozpúšťame a zohrievame na strednom ohni; pred vyprážaním má dosiahnuť 185 až 190 °C.
3. Vajcia, skysnuté mlieko, cukor a citrónový olej alebo citrónovú kôru vyšľaháme do svetlej peny. V inej mise zmiešame suché suroviny.

4. Maslo rozpustíme, ale dbáme, aby nebolo príliš horúce. Suché suroviny rýchlo spojíme s mokrými a vmiešame rozpustené maslo. Cesto bude dosť mäkké, ale ak budeme pracovnú plochu dôkladne posypávať múkou, poradíme si s ním.

6. Vykrajovačom na šišky (pred každým vykrojením ho namočíme do múky) vykrojíme šišky. Stredy si odložíme alebo ich zvaľkáme so zvyškami cesta a znova vykrojíme. S cestom pracujeme čo najmenej.

8. Obrátime ich ešte raz a vyprážame ďalších 30 sekúnd. Necháme odkvapkať na papierových utierkach (alebo na papierových vreckách).
9. Vychladnuté šišky dobre zabalené uchováme pri izbovej teplote niekoľko dní. Na dlhšie ich zmrazíme.

en.t: 100 g granulated sugar
2 tsp (10 ml) ground cinnamon
100 g confectioners’ sugar
45 g heavy cream or half-and-half (3 tbsp (44 ml))
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla paste or extract
Pinch kosher salt
240 ml water
84 g unsalted butter (about 6 tbsp), cut into 1.5 cm pieces
8 g (2 tsp) granulated sugar
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
128 g all-purpose flour, sifted
4 large eggs (about 200 g)
Neutral oil, such as canola, vegetable, or sunflower, for frying
1. For the Cinnamon Sugar: In a small bowl, whisk sugar and ground cinnamon to combine; set aside.
2. For the Glaze: In a small bowl, whisk confectioners’ sugar, heavy cream, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth; set aside.

3. For the Crullers: Cut fourteen 9 × 9 cm squares of parchment paper and arrange them on a 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking sheet. Set a wire rack inside another 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking sheet and line rack with a double layer of paper towels.
4. In a 2840 ml saucepan, combine water, butter, sugar, and salt. Set over high heat and cook until liquid comes to a rolling boil and butter has fully melted, about 2 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and add flour. Using a wooden spoon or stiff spatula, thoroughly mix in flour until no lumps remain.

6. Return saucepan to medium-high heat and cook, stirring constantly, until a thin starchy film forms all over the saucepan, dough pulls together into a cohesive mass, and dough registers 80 °C on an instant-read thermometer.
7. Transfer dough to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat on medium speed until dough registers 63 °C.

8. Reduce speed to low and add eggs one at a time, letting each fully incorporate before adding the next. Beat on medium speed until batter is cohesive, about 8 minutes. Scrape down bottom and sides of bowl, then mix once more at medium speed to ensure batter is fully mixed, about 5 seconds.

9. Fit a large piping bag with a 1.5 cm French star tip. Using a flexible spatula, scrape choux batter into piping bag. Snip off end of piping bag and pipe a 7.5 cm circle of choux pastry onto prepared parchment square; repeat with remaining batter.

10. In a large Dutch oven or pot, heat 5 cm of neutral oil over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Working in batches, carefully place 3 to 4 parchment squares, choux-side down, into the oil. Let cook for 1 minute, then use tongs to carefully peel away parchment. Cook, using a spider or slotted spoon to flip crullers halfway through, until crullers are deep golden brown on all sides, about 10 minutes, then transfer to prepared wire rack and let cool slightly. Repeat with remaining crullers.
11. Dip both sides in cinnamon sugar to evenly coat or dip top of cruller in vanilla glaze. Serve immediately.

1. Škoricový cukor: v malej miske metličkou zmiešame cukor a mletú škoricu; odložíme.

5. Odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme múku. Vareškou alebo pevnou stierkou ju dôkladne vmiešame, kým nezostanú žiadne hrudky.

6. Kastrólik vrátime na stredne silný až silný oheň a za stáleho miešania varíme, kým sa po celom dne kastrólika nevytvorí tenký škrobový povlak, cesto sa nespojí do súdržnej hmoty a vpichový teplomer v ňom neukáže 80 °C.

3. Using a dough scraper, scrape down sides of bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and set aside to rise at warm room temperature (about 22 to 25 °C) until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.
4. Using damp hands, gently deflate dough. Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or up to 18 hours.

1. To make the dough: Weigh your flour.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. In a medium bowl, whisk together the olive oil, water, and sour cream. Add the egg and vanilla and whisk to combine.

3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir vigorously with a flexible spatula until fully combined and homogenous, with no visible floury patches. Scoop the dough to one side of the bowl, grease the bowl lightly with olive oil, then turn the dough to coat. Cover the bowl with a reusable cover or plastic wrap and set aside for 15 minutes.

4. Perform a bowl fold: Grab a section of dough from one side, lift it up, then press it down into the middle. Repeat 3 to 6 times, rotating the bowl after each stretch, until you’ve circled the bowl and the dough feels stronger. Re-cover, then set aside for 15 minutes and perform a second bowl fold. Cover the bowl tightly and transfer it to the refrigerator to rise overnight (for at least 8 hours and up to 18 hours).

5. To shape the sufganiyot: Dust your work surface with flour. Dust the top of the dough with flour, then transfer it to the surface and gently deflate. Lightly dust the top of the dough and your hands with flour, then pat the dough to about 1.5 cm thick (about 28 cm x 20 cm in size). Use a floured 5.5 cm cutter to cut rounds of the dough and transfer them to parchment-lined baking sheets dusted with flour. Bring the scraps together once, then pat out the dough again to about 1.5 cm thick, and stamp out more rounds. Once you’ve made as many 5.5 cm rounds as you’d like, use a smaller cutter to make additional rounds (mini doughnuts!), which will reduce the amount of scrap dough leftover. (After you’ve re-rolled the scraps twice, cut the scraps into rough pieces to fry for a baker’s snack, or discard.) Transfer all the pieces of cut-out dough to the floured parchment.
6. Cover the baking sheets with reusable covers or greased plastic wrap and let them rise for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until very puffy.
7. To fry the sufganiyot: Towards the end of the rise time, heat about 5 cm of oil in a heavy-bottomed pot, like a Dutch oven, to between 175 °C and 185 °C.
8. To prepare for frying, line a baking sheet with paper towels. When the sufganiyot have risen, use scissors to cut the parchment so that each one is on its own individual piece.

9. When ready to fry, use the parchment to invert one piece of dough at a time into the hot oil (parchment-side up); soon, the parchment will release — use tongs to dispose of it. (If the parchment doesn’t easily release, don’t worry: It will when you flip the sufganiyot.)

Insert the pastry tip or the squeeze bottle into the hole and pipe in about 1 tbsp (15 ml) of jam; you’ve added too much if the jam starts peeking out.

1. Cesto: múku odvážime.
2. Vo veľkej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, cukor, droždie a soľ. V strednej mise vymiešame olivový olej, vodu a kyslú smotanu. Pridáme vajce a vanilku a metličkou premiešame.

3. Mokré suroviny pridáme k suchým a ohybnou stierkou energicky miešame, kým nie je cesto úplne spojené a jednoliate, bez viditeľných múčnych miest. Cesto presunieme na jednu stranu misy, misu zľahka vymastíme olivovým olejom a cesto v ňom obrátime. Misu prikryjeme pokrievkou alebo fóliou a necháme 15 minút odpočívať.

4. Prekladanie v mise: uchopíme časť cesta z jednej strany, nadvihneme ju a pritlačíme do stredu. Opakujeme 3- až 6-krát a misu po každom natiahnutí pootočíme, kým neprejdeme celý obvod a cesto nie je pevnejšie. Znova prikryjeme, necháme 15 minút odpočívať a cesto preložíme ešte raz. Misu tesne prikryjeme a necháme cesto kysnúť v chladničke cez noc (aspoň 8 a najviac 18 hodín).

5. Tvarovanie: pracovnú plochu poprášime múkou. Múkou poprášime aj povrch cesta, preložíme ho na plochu a jemne stlačíme. Povrch cesta aj ruky zľahka pomúčime a cesto roztlačíme na hrúbku asi 1,5 cm (približne 28 × 20 cm). Pomúčeným vykrajovačom s priemerom 5,5 cm vykrajujeme kruhy a prekladáme ich na plechy vystlané papierom na pečenie a poprášené múkou. Zvyšky cesta raz spojíme, opäť roztlačíme na hrúbku asi 1,5 cm a vykrojíme ďalšie kruhy. Keď máme dosť kruhov s priemerom 5,5 cm, menším vykrajovačom vykrojíme ďalšie (mini šišky!), aby zostalo čo najmenej zvyškov. (Po dvoch zvaľkaniach nakrájame zvyšky na nepravidelné kúsky, ktoré vypražíme ako maškrtu pre kuchára, alebo ich vyhodíme.) Všetky vykrojené kúsky preložíme na pomúčený papier.
6. Plechy prikryjeme pokrievkou alebo vymastenou fóliou a necháme kysnúť 45 minút až 1 hodinu, kým cesto výrazne nenabobtná.
7. Vyprážanie: ku koncu kysnutia zohrejeme v hrnci s hrubým dnom (napríklad liatinovom) asi 5 cm oleja na 175 až 185 °C.
8. Plech vystelieme papierovými utierkami. Keď sú šišky vykysnuté, nožnicami rozstrihneme papier tak, aby bola každá na samostatnom kúsku.
9. Šišky po jednej pomocou papiera obrátime do horúceho oleja (papierom nahor); papier sa čoskoro uvoľní a vyberieme ho kliešťami. (Ak sa papier ľahko neuvoľní, nevadí, uvoľní sa pri obracaní.)
10. Vyprážame naraz 3 až 4 šišky, aby hrniec nebol preplnený, kým nie sú zospodu hnedé, asi 1 až 2 minúty. Kliešťami ich obrátime a vyprážame druhú stranu ešte 1 až 2 minúty.
11. Dierovanou naberačkou preložíme šišky na plech s papierovými utierkami. Pokračujeme, kým nie sú všetky vyprážané; medzi dávkami necháme olej znova zohriať na požadovanú teplotu.

12. Keď šišky trochu vychladnú, v širokej plytkej mise alebo koláčovej forme rozotrieme pomarančovú kôru s kryštálovým cukrom, kým nie je zmes vlhká a voňavá. Pridáme práškový cukor a metličkou premiešame. Šišky po jednej či dvoch vkladáme do misy a zľahka ich obalíme. (Ak chceme viac cukru, obalíme ich druhýkrát.)

13. Plnenie: špajdľou, pevnou slamkou alebo paličkou urobíme do boku každej šišky otvor; nástrojom niekoľkokrát pootočíme, aby vznikla v strede malá dutina. Lekvárom (džemom) naplníme cukrárske vrecko s okrúhlou špičkou alebo stláčaciu fľašu. Špičku zasunieme do otvoru a vstriekneme asi 1 PL (15 ml) lekváru; ak lekvár začne vykúkať z otvoru, je ho priveľa.
14. Uchovávanie: plnené šišky sú najlepšie v deň vyprážania, hoci zvyšok (či dva) na raňajky nasledujúci deň nikoho nesklame. Naplnené šišky podávame ihneď (alebo čo najskôr).

Increase speed to medium and knead until dough is uniform, shiny, and sticky, about 8 minutes (dough will not clear bottom or sides of bowl).
2. Using greased rubber spatula, transfer dough to greased large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until doubled in size, 1½ to 2 hours.

3. Brush rimmed baking sheet with 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil. Turn out dough onto sheet and gently press down to deflate. Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and evenly space pieces on sheet. Using your greased hands, pat each piece of dough into 9 cm disk (about 1 cm thick). Cover sheet with plastic and let dough rise at room temperature until puffy, 30 to 45 minutes.

4. Set wire rack in second rimmed baking sheet. Add remaining 1890 ml oil to large Dutch oven until it measures about 4 cm deep and heat over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Gently drop 4 dough disks into hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3 minutes, flipping disks halfway through frying. Adjust burner, if necessary, to maintain oil temperature between 165 and 175 °C.

5. Using slotted spoon or spider skimmer, transfer malasadas to prepared wire rack. Return oil to 175 °C and repeat with remaining dough disks in 2 batches. Place remaining 235 ml sugar in large bowl. Lightly toss malasadas, one at a time, in sugar to coat. Transfer to platter. Serve immediately.

en.t: 120 ml filtered water
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)
285 g, spooned all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal Unbleached
1 tbsp (12 g) baking powder
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt
2 tbsp (28 g) cold, unsalted butter, cut into 4 pieces
1890 ml vegetable oil, for frying

1. In a medium bowl, whisk water and egg until smooth and well combined; set aside. In the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt until thoroughly combined, about 30 seconds. Add butter and egg mixture. Set bowl onto stand mixer and, using a dough hook, mix on low speed until liquids are absorbed and no dry flour remains, about 3 minutes.

2. Increase speed to medium-low and mix until butter is fully incorporated and dough starts to clear sides of bowl, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer dough to a bare work surface, knead for 30 seconds, and shape into a 23 cm log. Press log flat to 2 cm thickness. Wrap log in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 12 hours or up to 24 hours.

3. To shape the dough and prepare for frying: Remove dough from refrigerator and bring to room temperature, somewhere between 20 and 22 °C, around 2 to 3 hours. Unwrap dough and transfer to a well-floured work surface. Roll dough into a 25 cm by 15 cm rectangle. Using a pizza cutter or bench knife, divide dough into ten 2.5 cm by 15 cm strips. Cover dough loosely with a damp paper towel.

4. Working with one strip at a time, cut in half crosswise to form two 7.5 cm strips. Brush the unfloured top side of one 7.5 cm strip lightly with water, then layer the second 7.5 cm strip, unfloured side down, directly on top. Lay a chopstick lengthwise along the middle of the layered dough strip and press firmly to seal the strips together and form a groove. Repeat with remaining strips of dough and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let dough strips rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until it registers 204 °C on an instant-read thermometer; adjust heat as necessary to maintain this frying temperature. Set a wire rack on a rimmed baking sheet, and have a spider or chopsticks and salt (and/or other seasonings) nearby.

5. To fry the youtiao: Working with one dough strip at a time, hold both ends of dough and stretch to 20–25 cm in length. Carefully lower dough into heated oil, gently laying the strip away from you, then immediately stretch a second strip of dough and add it carefully to the oil. Cook until dough sticks begin to float, about 10 seconds. Using chopsticks or a slotted spoon, flip dough sticks and cook for 10 to 15 seconds longer, then continue flipping dough sticks in 10- to 15-second intervals until dough is puffed and golden brown, about 90 seconds total. Using a spider, transfer fried dough to the wire rack set in the rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Return oil to 205 °C and repeat with remaining dough. Serve immediately.

3. To shape the dough and prepare for frying: Remove dough from refrigerator and bring to room temperature, somewhere between 20 and 22 °C, around 2 to 3 hours. Unwrap dough and transfer to a well-floured work surface. Roll dough into a 25 cm by 15 cm rectangle. Using a pizza cutter or bench knife, divide dough into ten 2.5 cm by 15 cm strips. Cover dough loosely with a damp paper towel.

4. Working with one strip at a time, cut in half crosswise to form two 7.5 cm strips. Brush the unfloured top side of one 7.5 cm strip lightly with water, then layer the second 7.5 cm strip, unfloured side down, directly on top. Lay a chopstick lengthwise along the middle of the layered dough strip and press firmly to seal the strips together and form a groove. Repeat with remaining strips of dough and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Let dough strips rest for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until it registers 204 °C on an instant-read thermometer; adjust heat as necessary to maintain this frying temperature. Set a wire rack on a rimmed baking sheet, and have a spider or chopsticks and salt (and/or other seasonings) nearby.

5. To fry the youtiao: Working with one dough strip at a time, hold both ends of dough and stretch to 20–25 cm in length. Carefully lower dough into heated oil, gently laying the strip away from you, then immediately stretch a second strip of dough and add it carefully to the oil. Cook until dough sticks begin to float, about 10 seconds. Using chopsticks or a slotted spoon, flip dough sticks and cook for 10 to 15 seconds longer, then continue flipping dough sticks in 10- to 15-second intervals until dough is puffed and golden brown, about 90 seconds total. Using a spider, transfer fried dough to the wire rack set in the rimmed baking sheet. Sprinkle with kosher salt. Return oil to 205 °C and repeat with remaining dough. Serve immediately.

1. V strednej mise metličkou vymiešame vodu s vajcom dohladka; odložíme. V mise kuchynského robota metličkou dôkladne zmiešame múku, prášok do pečiva a soľ, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme maslo a vaječnú zmes. Misu nasadíme na robot a hákom na cesto miešame na nízkej rýchlosti, kým sa tekutiny nevsiaknu a nezostane žiadna suchá múka, asi 3 minúty.

2. Rýchlosť zvýšime na strednú až nízku a miesime, kým sa maslo úplne nezapracuje a cesto sa nezačne odlepovať od stien misy, 10 až 12 minút. Cesto preložíme na nepomúčenú pracovnú plochu, 30 sekúnd ho miesime a vytvarujeme valec dlhý 23 cm. Valec stlačíme na hrúbku 2 cm. Zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke aspoň 12 a najviac 24 hodín.

3. Tvarovanie a príprava na vyprážanie: cesto vyberieme z chladničky a necháme ho zohriať na izbovú teplotu (približne 20 až 22 °C), asi 2 až 3 hodiny. Cesto rozbalíme a preložíme na dobre pomúčenú pracovnú plochu. Vyvaľkáme ho na obdĺžnik 25 × 15 cm. Kolieskom na pizzu alebo škrabkou ho rozdelíme na desať pásikov 2,5 × 15 cm. Cesto voľne prikryjeme vlhkou papierovou utierkou.

4. Pásiky spracúvame po jednom: každý priečne prekrojíme na dva pásiky dlhé 7,5 cm. Nepomúčenú vrchnú stranu jedného 7,5 cm pásika zľahka potrieme vodou a priamo naň položíme druhý 7,5 cm pásik nepomúčenou stranou nadol. Pozdĺž stredu položíme paličku na jedenie a pevne pritlačíme, aby sa pásiky spojili a vznikla ryha. Rovnako spracujeme zvyšné pásiky a voľne ich prikryjeme fóliou. Necháme 10 minút odpočívať. Medzitým v liatinovom hrnci na stredne silnom až silnom ohni zohrejeme olej, kým vpichový teplomer neukáže 204 °C; plameň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa táto teplota udržala. Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a nachystáme si cedidlovú naberačku alebo paličky a soľ (prípadne iné koreniny).

5. Vyprážanie: pásiky spracúvame po jednom; chytíme cesto za oba konce a natiahneme ho na dĺžku 20 až 25 cm. Opatrne ho spustíme do horúceho oleja smerom od seba a hneď natiahneme a do oleja opatrne vložíme aj druhý pásik. Vyprážame, kým pásiky nevyplávajú na povrch, asi 10 sekúnd. Paličkami alebo dierovanou naberačkou ich obrátime a vyprážame ešte 10 až 15 sekúnd; potom ich obraciame každých 10 až 15 sekúnd, kým nie sú nafúknuté a zlatohnedé, spolu asi 90 sekúnd. Cedidlovou naberačkou ich preložíme na mriežku v plechu. Posypeme hrubou soľou. Olej opäť zohrejeme na 205 °C a rovnako vypražíme zvyšné cesto. Podávame ihneď.

en.t: 42 g unsalted butter (3 tbsp), cut into pieces
2 large Granny Smith apples (about 226 g each), peeled and cut into 0.5 cm pieces
2 tsp (10 ml) fresh lemon juice from 1 medium lemon
130 g granulated sugar, divided
1 tsp (5 ml) plus a pinch Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
Canola oil, for frying
355 g all-purpose flour
2 tsp (8 g) baking powder
3/4 tsp (3 g) apple pie spice
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell), lightly beaten
120 ml whole milk
85 g sour cream
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
285 g confectioners’ sugar
5 tbsp (75 ml) apple cider
Pinch kosher salt

1. For the Apple Fritters: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Cook, whisking constantly with a wooden spoon, until milk solids sink to the bottom of the skillet and turn light golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Add apples and stir to evenly coat in butter. Cook, stirring occasionally, until apples are crisp-tender and still hold their shape, about 5 minutes. Add lemon juice, 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the sugar, and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves and apples are glazed in sugar mixture, about 2 minutes. Transfer apples to a large plate and refrigerate until cool, about 20 minutes.
2. Set a wire rack inside a 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking sheet; set aside. Fill a large Dutch oven with 4 cm of canola oil and heat over medium-high until oil is 190 °C.

3. In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, apple pie spice, remaining 120 ml sugar, and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt to combine; set aside. In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, milk, sour cream, and vanilla to combine. Add sour cream mixture and cooked apples to dry ingredients, and, using a flexible spatula, fold together until a thick batter forms.

4. Working in batches of 3, carefully drop about 120 ml of batter into hot oil and, using the back of a spoon, immediately press fritter until fritter is about 10 cm in diameter. Fry, adjusting heat as needed to maintain temperature, and use a spider skimmer or slotted spoon to flip fritters halfway through. Cook until fritters are browned, puffed, and cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer finished fritters to prepared wire rack and repeat with remaining fritters.

5. For the Glaze: In a medium bowl, whisk confectioners’ sugar, apple cider, and salt until smooth. Working with one fritter at a time, dip top of fritter into glaze, allowing excess glaze to drip off. Return fritter to wire rack, glaze side up. Repeat with remaining fritters. Serve warm or at room temperature.

1. Jablkové fritters: vo veľkej panvici rozpustíme maslo na strednom ohni. Za stáleho miešania varíme, kým mliečne bielkoviny neklesnú na dno panvice a nezozlatnú, 3 až 4 minúty. Pridáme jablká a premiešame, aby sa rovnomerne obalili maslom. Za občasného miešania dusíme, kým jablká nezmäknú, no zostanú chrumkavé a držia tvar, asi 5 minút. Pridáme citrónovú šťavu, 1½ PL (22 ml) cukru a štipku soli. Za stáleho miešania varíme, kým sa cukor nerozpustí a jablká sa neglazujú, asi 2 minúty. Jablká preložíme na veľký tanier a necháme vychladnúť v chladničke, asi 20 minút.
2. Do plechu s okrajom 33 × 46 cm vložíme mriežku; odložíme. Veľký liatinový hrniec naplníme repkovým olejom do výšky 4 cm a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni ho zohrejeme na 190 °C.

3. Vo veľkej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, prášok do pečiva, korenie na jablkový koláč, zvyšných 90 ml cukru a 1 ČL (5 ml) soli; odložíme. V strednej mise vymiešame vajcia, mlieko, kyslú smotanu a vanilku. Smotanovú zmes a podusené jablká pridáme k suchým surovinám a ohybnou stierkou zľahka premiešame, kým nevznikne husté cesto.

4. Po dávkach po 3 kusoch opatrne vložíme do horúceho oleja asi 120 ml cesta a zadnou stranou lyžice ho hneď roztlačíme na placku s priemerom asi 10 cm. Vyprážame a plameň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa udržala teplota; v polovici vyprážania lievance cedidlovou alebo dierovanou naberačkou obrátime. Vyprážame, kým nie sú zhnednuté, nafúknuté a prepečené, asi 5 minút. Hotové lievance preložíme na pripravenú mriežku a rovnako vypražíme zvyšné.

5. Poleva: v strednej mise metličkou vymiešame práškový cukor, nealkoholický kalný jablkový mušt a soľ dohladka. Fritters po jednom namočíme vrchnou stranou do polevy a prebytok necháme stiecť. Vrátime ich na mriežku polevou nahor. Rovnako oblejeme zvyšné. Podávame teplé alebo izbovej teploty.
